text:
maya: Heads-up — finance experiment proposal for Private renewals. Quick alignment before we loop in legal/sales. TL;DR: pilot a 10% platform-fee credit for customers who upgrade from Standard -> Premium support at renewal for one quarter. Want to surface risks/ops gaps and an estimated revenue impact.
kevin: Can you share the expected list of customers and ARR impact? 10% sounds material.
samira: How do we message this to customers? We don’t want churn or confusion at renewal windows. Also need to know if it's retroactive.
maya: Not retroactive. Targeting renewals between May 1–Jul 31. I'll attach a segment query in a sec. Main goal: nudge higher support tier adoption to reduce ops load.
oliver: Billing/true-up concern: will this be applied as a one-time credit line-item, or do we change recurring invoice SKUs? If one-time, we need invoice attachment flow in Zuora.
julia: Legal — we'll need guardrails in contract language and a short addendum template. Also ensure the credit can't be combined with other promos.
finance-bot: Simulation complete for pilot cohort (sample n=42). Estimated gross revenue delta: -$46.2k (credits) vs. incremental ARR upside if 30% upgrade conversion => +$128k annual. Details uploaded to /drive/fin-experiments/1940001111-sim.xlsx.
kevin: Good to have numbers. We should cap total credits per customer to avoid gaming. Propose $25k cap per account.
maya: Agreed on cap. Also propose opt-in flag so sales can choose customers (pilot only).
oliver: Implementation notes: we can create a one-off credit invoice item via billing API. Code snippet for target customers: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, current_support_tier, next_renewal_date, annual_platform_fee
FROM private_customers
WHERE current_support_tier = 'Standard' AND next_renewal_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-07-31';
```
We'll need a revops runbook for manual credits too.
samira: For messaging: short email + one-sheeter. Sales has to opt customers in within the CRM by Apr 20. Can product/marketing help with copy?
maya: Product will draft messaging. Marketing will give final.
julia: I can draft a one-paragraph addendum and an internal checklist for approvals.
kevin: Approval question — finance pre-approves pilot up to $50k in credits total. Anything above needs CFO sign-off. Also require quarterly revenue review post-pilot.
maya: Noted. Who will own the tracking dashboard? Need a daily snapshot of applied credits and upgrade conversions.
finance-bot: I can emit daily webhook with two metrics: total_credits_applied, upgrade_conversion_rate. Endpoint created: https://hooks.internal.redwood/fin/pilot-1940001111
oliver: I'll add the webhook to the dashboard and create the revops runbook for manual cases.
samira: Sales will compile a prioritized account list by Apr 10 and add to the CRM opt-in list.
maya: OK — next steps: (1) samira sends opt-in list by Apr 10, (2) julia drafts addendum by Apr 14, (3) oliver & revops implement credit flow + dashboard by Apr 20, (4) kevin confirms cap & budget (finance pre-approval) — I'll schedule a quick review on Apr 21.
kevin: Sounds good. One more ask: please add a cancellation guard (if customer cancels within 90 days after renewal, we clawback credit). Legal to confirm feasibility.
julia: Will validate clawback language.
maya: Thanks all — moving this into a pilot ticket now. cc @billing-bot for invoice monitoring. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-PILOT-1940001111 created and assigned to revops. Invoice monitor will alert if any manual credits exceed $10k per account.
kevin: Approved for pilot under the stated constraints. If legal ok, finance signs off.
maya: Perfect — closing thread and will post the ticket link when created.
